title: Simsola AI
impact: Delivered scalable leadership training at significantly lower cost with measurable behavioral insights
description: An AI-powered leadership development platform that uses conversational role-play simulations grounded in developmental psychology, helping organizations scale leadership training through interactive and adaptive experiences.
challenge: Building a scalable system to replace expensive one-on-one human-led leadership training with an adaptive AI-driven experience while maintaining personalization and measurable outcomes.
approach: Designed and developed a full-stack AI simulation platform leveraging GPT-based conversational systems, structured scenario generation, and feedback loops to deliver personalized leadership coaching.
solution: Built a full-stack platform with a conversational role-play engine, dynamic scenario generation, analytics dashboards, and role-based portals, supported by scalable backend infrastructure and cloud deployment.

title: SteerHealth
impact: Increased bookings by 186% and improved patient retention and referrals
description: A SaaS healthcare platform designed to connect marketing, operational, clinical, and financial workflows to improve patient experience and drive growth for healthcare organisations.
challenge: To connect patients with healthcare organisations quickly, retain them over time, and provide a unified solution for accessing medical services with a seamless user experience.
approach: Developed a platform providing digital tools for patients such as appointments, chat, treatment information, payments, and insurance details, along with a dashboard for organisations to manage these features.
solution: Built a SaaS platform in iterative sprints with features including appointment scheduling, registration, onboarding, report generation, secure payments, and a client-side dashboard for management.
features: Chat requests between patients and providers

title: Girls First Finance
impact: Increased website traffic by 200% with growing user base and engagement
description: A web and mobile platform designed to provide financial support and resources for girls, enabling access to funding for education, living expenses, and enterprise ideas.
challenge: Many girls face sexual exploitation in exchange for financial support such as tuition, jobs, or training, creating a need for safe and accessible funding solutions.
approach: Developed a platform focused on providing safe financial access, enabling girls to apply for loans, track finances, and connect with mentors.
solution: Built a web and mobile application with features for loan calculation, loan request tracking, financial history management, and mentor interaction.
features: Mentor following system in mobile app

title: Troop Travel
impact: Users increased by 20% annually with significant travel time, cost, and CO2 savings
description: A backend system developed for Troop Travel to support planning of trips including flights, hotels, and rentals in a unified platform.
challenge: Lack of a single platform to plan trips, accommodations, and activities seamlessly in one place.
approach: Focused on building a backend system to support multiple travel-related services such as itinerary planning, hotel bookings, car rentals, and flights.
solution: Developed the backend using Node.js and GraphQL to manage flights, hotels, and rental services for the platform.

title: Darlink
impact: Improved user retention by 60% and enhanced emotional well-being for users
description: An AI companion platform designed to deliver personalized conversations that adapt to users and enhance emotional connection.
challenge: Enhancing user experience by creating meaningful and engaging conversational interactions.
approach: Focused on building a conversational platform that adapts to users and delivers personalized interactions.
solution: Developed a web platform that enables smart conversations aimed at improving engagement and emotional connection.

title: EMSTEEL
impact: Enabled real-time visibility into industrial assets, improving maintenance efficiency and operational monitoring through QR-based tracking and network-integrated data systems
description: An industrial asset tracking web application used by EMSTEEL Group to monitor equipment, maintenance history, and sensor data through QR-code scans, integrated with a private 5G network pilot.
challenge: Tracking industrial equipment, maintenance history, and live sensor data across facilities is complex, especially without a unified system that supports real-time updates and reliable connectivity in large-scale environments.
approach: Developed a full-stack system combining QR-based asset identification with centralized data management and network-integrated monitoring, ensuring seamless access to asset data and maintenance records.
solution: Built a web application that enables QR-based asset scanning, maintenance tracking, and real-time monitoring of equipment and sensor data, integrated with a private 5G network for reliable and fast data transmission.
features: QR-code based asset identification and tracking
Equipment monitoring with real-time data access
Sensor data integration for asset monitoring
Support for private 5G network-based data flow

title: RealdealAI
impact: Improved transaction efficiency and streamlined deal management workflows for real estate professionals
description: An AI-powered real estate workflow automation platform focused on transaction management, listing management, and operational efficiency for agents and brokers.
challenge: Real estate transactions involve complex, multi-step workflows with manual coordination, making it difficult to manage listings, track deal progress, and maintain operational efficiency.
approach: Developed a full-stack platform with AI-driven automation to streamline transaction workflows, improve listing management, and provide tools tailored for agents and brokers.
solution: Built a web application with automated workflow management, listing tools, and user-focused interfaces, enabling real estate professionals to manage deals and operations efficiently.

title: Agent Flow AI
impact: Enabled instant generation of structured startup plans, reducing early-stage planning effort from hours to seconds
description: A multi-agent AI orchestration platform that converts raw startup ideas into structured, execution-ready product plans across product, generatorure, business, and QA domains.
challenge: Startup ideas are often vague and require multiple roles (PM, generator, business strategist, QA) to turn into actionable plans. This process is slow, fragmented, and difficult to standardize.
approach: Designed a role-based multi-agent system with controlled prompt orchestration, where each agent produces structured outputs that feed into a unified planning response.
solution: Built a centralized orchestration API using Next.js that dispatches domain-specific prompts to Gemini, aggregates responses, and renders them in a structured UI with visual workflow mapping.
features: Multi-agent orchestration pipeline (PM, generator, Business, QA)
Single API entrypoint for full-plan generation
Structured outputs segmented by role for clarity
Tabbed interface for fast navigation across agent responses
Visual workflow canvas representing agent execution flow
Reusable prompt generatorure for scalable agent addition

title: AI Business Analyst
impact: Enabled evidence-backed business insights with traceable reasoning across large document sets
description: AI Business Analyst is a document-grounded business intelligence assistant built on an Agentic RAG workflow. It ingests business documents, chunks and stores them in MongoDB, retrieves relevant evidence using vector search with fallback ranking, and returns structured answers with confidence and evidence traces.
challenge: Business teams struggle to extract actionable insights from large document collections, while traditional RAG systems lack reasoning transparency, confidence validation, and adaptive query planning.
approach: Designed an agentic planner-executor loop that dynamically retrieves, evaluates, and refines responses using semantic search, confidence scoring, and iterative re-planning.
solution: Built a full-stack system using Next.js and MongoDB that combines vector search with an agent-based reasoning pipeline, enabling multi-step analysis, evidence tracing, and structured output generation.
features: Multi-document upload and persistent document management
Semantic chunking and embedding generation for retrieval
Agentic planner-executor loop with dynamic re-planning
Multi-step reasoning: retrieval, analysis, recommendations, synthesis
Traceable outputs linking insights to source documents

Central dashboard for managing documents and executing business intelligence queries.
Structured responses with evidence links, confidence scores, and reasoning traces.
Multi-document ingestion pipeline with semantic processing and embedding generation.

title: DocMind AI
impact: Enabled fast, context-grounded document Q&A with controlled response modes for accuracy and flexibility
description: An AI-powered document intelligence platform that allows users to upload PDFs, index their content using vector embeddings, and perform high-speed, context-aware question answering using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
challenge: Reviewing large PDF documents is time-consuming, and traditional LLM systems often produce ungrounded or overly generic responses without strict adherence to source content.
approach: Designed a RAG pipeline with structured document ingestion, semantic chunking, and configurable response modes to balance strict grounding with flexible expert-level insights.
solution: Built a full-stack Next.js application integrating MongoDB vector search and Groq-powered inference to deliver real-time, document-aware responses with selectable behavior modes.
features: PDF upload and automated text extraction pipeline
Semantic chunking and embedding generation for retrieval
MongoDB vector search for high-speed similarity matching
Strict mode for fully grounded, source-only answers
Expert mode for document-based insights with extended reasoning
Summary mode for concise, high-level outputs
Persistent document catalog for ongoing query access

gallery.caption: Central dashboard for uploading, managing, and querying documents.
Central dashboard for uploading, managing, and querying documents.
Document ingestion pipeline that processes PDFs into semantic chunks for retrieval.
Interactive Q&A interface with selectable response modes for different levels of grounding and detail.

title: AI Voice Calling Agent
impact: Enabled real-time, multilingual AI phone conversations with sub-second latency using streaming audio pipelines
description: A real-time AI voice agent designed to handle live phone calls using Twilio Media Streams, performing speech-to-text, LLM-based response generation, and speech synthesis in a low-latency streaming pipeline.
challenge: Building real-time voice agents for phone calls requires handling streaming audio, low-latency processing, language detection, and seamless bidirectional communication over telephony systems.
approach: Designed a streaming pipeline integrating Twilio Media Streams with custom STT, LLM, and TTS components, focusing on low-latency processing, multilingual support, and interruption handling.
solution: Implemented a Node.js WebSocket server connected to Twilio Voice, with a Python-based STT/TTS backend and Groq-powered LLM responses, enabling real-time bidirectional audio streaming over phone calls.
features: Real-time phone call handling using Twilio Media Streams (WebSocket)
Bidirectional audio streaming between caller and AI system
Voice activity detection (VAD) for speech boundary detection
Automatic language detection across English, Hindi, Telugu, Tamil, and Gujarati
Chunked text-to-speech synthesis for low-latency responses
Multilingual Piper TTS synthesis for natural voice output
Echo suppression and interruption handling during live calls
Configurable greeting message on call connection

title: Proposal Generate
impact: Reduced proposal drafting time by leveraging historical data for fast, consistent, and context-grounded responses
description: An AI-powered proposal generation system that uses retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to draft client-ready proposals based on historical proposal data.
challenge: Proposal creation is often repetitive, time-consuming, and inconsistent across teams, with valuable historical knowledge remaining underutilized.
approach: Designed a RAG-based system that converts historical proposals into a searchable knowledge base using embeddings and vector similarity, ensuring responses are grounded in prior data.
solution: Built a full-stack application using Next.js, Express, and PostgreSQL with vector search, integrating local embedding generation and Groq-based LLM inference to produce context-aware proposal drafts.
features: Proposal knowledge base ingestion via API
Semantic similarity search over stored proposals
AI-generated proposal drafting grounded in retrieved context
Relevance scoring and ranking of retrieved proposals
Similarity thresholding to reduce weak or ungrounded responses
Automatic embedding generation during proposal ingestion
Automatic vector search and response generation on each query
Returns generated proposal along with supporting source records
Simple UI for requirement input and output review
